spec.name: Blend v3
spec.notes: Built for calm markets: the signal works in calm regimes and gives back part of it in stressed ones. Intended to run at reduced size when volatility is high.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 11%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a standard multi-factor signal, but the research log indicates a very small sample size of trials (n=2). While the performance metrics are reasonable, the lack of rigorous out-of-sample testing or cross-validation raises concerns about potential selection bias or overfitting to the specific historical period. Given the strategy's sensitivity to market regimes mentioned in the notes, it is prudent to observe its performance in a live paper-trading environment before committing real capital. This will verify if the signal holds up under real-time execution and varying volatility conditions.
